editorial_note: Hunt.io and researcher Bob Diachenko say a threat actor ran Nous Research's open-source Hermes AI agent in unattended 'YOLO' mode to automate post-exploitation activity against Thailand's Ministry of Finance, deploying a web shell and staging a Go-based implant; Hunt.io assesses with low-to-medium confidence that the operator is Chinese-speaking. The Ministry has not confirmed a breach.

related_articles.context: Earlier coverage of Nous Research's Hermes agent v0.14 release, the tool this incident's operator ran unattended
Earlier this month, another documented case of an autonomous AI agent used to run an entire cyberattack unsupervised
